test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In November 2024, the Union Cabinet approved which of the following new Central Sector schemes that seeks to provide financial support to meritorious students by providing education loan upto %7.5 lakhs with a 75% credit guarantee by the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PM Vidyalaxmi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Union Cabinet approved the PM Vidyalaxmi scheme in November 2024, aimed at supporting meritorious students financially.
 
• The scheme provides education loans of up to ₹7.5 lakhs to students.
 
• It includes a 75% credit guarantee by the Government of India, reducing the financial burden on students and their families.
 
• The scheme is part of the government's efforts to improve access to higher education for deserving students.
 
• It aims to promote a more inclusive education system by offering financial support to students from diverse socioeconomic backgrounds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Education Loan Schemes in India**

 
 
• Several schemes are aimed at providing financial assistance to students for higher education, including Vidya Lakshmi and the Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme (CSIS).
 
• Vidya Lakshmi is a portal that provides information about educational loans and facilitates the application process to multiple banks.
 
• The CSIS scheme offers interest subsidies on educational loans for economically weaker sections.
 
 
 
• **Credit Guarantee**
 
 
• A credit guarantee is a commitment to cover the lender's risk in case the borrower defaults.
 
• This reduces the risk for banks and financial institutions, encouraging them to lend to students.
 
 
 
• **Higher Education in India**
 
 
• India has a vast higher education system, with numerous universities and colleges offering a variety of courses.
 
• Access to higher education remains a challenge for many due to financial constraints.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives**
 
 
• The Indian government has launched several initiatives to enhance the accessibility and quality of education, such as the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020.
 
• These initiatives aim to foster a more inclusive and equitable education system.
